scope: Finite stress cases. No control retuning based on these outputs.
primary: Stop within absolute 5m; keep failures and signed overshoot
measurement: Delay all measured physical quantities by queue ticks; observation Tick denotes command time, not sensor sample time. Warm-up repeats first sample. Grip drops to 60% at 450m relative displacement. Brake-force mismatch changes only ServiceBrakeN in a plant config copy, not production source. Raw jerk uses 20ms acceleration difference; moving jerk excludes adjacent speeds <=0.5m/s. Pressure-volume totals are proxies, not certified gas mass/energy.
restrictions: Two seeds per finite profile do not provide independent field evidence. Do not infer passenger comfort or safety certification. Do not claim braking response-rate mismatch: this suite varies force capability, not pressure rates. Reference grid success does not establish performance on these stresses.
